observed_content: A Hephaestus synthesis records shared Projects as project-only memory and preserves the distinction between documented 10-file-at-once guidance and separately observed larger drag-and-drop behavior rather than collapsing them into one universal limit.

Patrick instructed the Star Trek Corpus Librarian that source inventory is not literary interpretation or close reading and that a book must never be described as read merely because it was scanned, indexed, parsed, searched, fingerprinted, or inspected.

subject: STAR_TREK_CORPUS_GOVERNANCE
memory_summary: Corpus handling distinguishes source/work binding, indexing, and close reading. File presence and mechanical inspection do not establish source completeness, preferred identity, semantic correctness, or a claim that the work was read. Trek research workers may progress asynchronously and reconcile evidence later.

Patrick explicitly rejects equating scan/index/parse/search/fingerprint/inspection with reading.

inference.interpretation: The governing design favors evidence-preserving specialization over progress metrics that collapse different kinds of work into one status word.

meaning: In the Trek corpus program, source/work binding, mechanical indexing, and close reading are separate activities with separate evidence. Do not promote one into another, and allow asynchronous workers to reconcile after independent progress.

currentness_rule: Product-specific facts require fresh verification when used time-sensitively; Trek role instructions remain current only until directly superseded by newer project governance.
